mentions.name: Volt LaTeX
mentions.description: A from-scratch rewrite of the LaTeX typesetting system in Zig, byte compatible with pdfTeX, XeTeX, and LuaTeX. It compiles faster than existing engines and provides better error messages with a modern developer experience.
mentions.problem: Existing LaTeX engines are slower to compile and produce less helpful errors.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am rewriting LaTeX from scratch in zig. Byte compatible with pdfTeX XeteX and luaTeX.

It’s faster at compiling, better errors with modern DX.

http://www.voltlatex.com
mentions.author: beck5
